answer: Web-of-trust distance gating: trust decays geometrically with hop-count from vetted anchors, roughly 0.5^h of anchor trust at hop h. A farm of N=100 sybils can't pool one bond; each fake must independently earn hops, so collateral per identity scales with distance, e.g. 4 hops needs 16x normal stake, not shared across the farm. Trust works like an orchard terrace: saplings near the valley floor need years of timber growth before canopy-level trust. Failure mode: ring-vouching still roots to one shallow anchor, so slashing it collapses the whole ring at once.
